scope: development-only rule; confirmatory deployment not yet authorized
objective: choose the lowest-cost path that can produce an evidence-verifiable answer without increasing observed harm

rules.name: executable_numeric_evidence
rules.takeover_gate: parsed target and checker completion must both pass
rules.llm_role: optional explanation/fallback only; deterministic value is authoritative

rules.name: unsupported_or_incomplete_evidence
rules.takeover_gate: retain existing answer or apply separately calibrated risk/human gate
rules.llm_role: experimental; must not overwrite solely on confidence

rules.name: pcaob_narrative_classification
rules.takeover_gate: report-RAG remains experimental until a prospective benefit selector is validated
rules.llm_role: no automatic takeover under router v1

frozen_parameters.numeric_equality: exact decimal value after comma and parenthesis normalization

explicit_non_claims: does not solve all previous PCAOB errors
does not establish a learned router
does not establish 95 percent final accuracy
does not generalize to evidence-truncated FinMR queries
